warnings.title: Extraction warnings
warnings.pagePartial: some text could not be recovered
warnings.pageUnreadable: the page was reported as unreadable
warnings.duplicatePage: the text resembles another long page
warnings.unicodeReplacement: the text contains a replacement character
warnings.unknown: the extraction reported a quality warning

pages.title: Text by page
pages.noText: No readable text was recovered from this page.

analysisWarnings.title: Analysis notes — saving is not blocked
analysisWarnings.wordingChanged: A supporting passage is not a verbatim match on its indicated page or in the source text. It may have been reformulated or combined across pages; this does not establish whether its meaning is correct.
analysisWarnings.evidencePage: A supporting passage references a page that is not present in the extracted text.
analysisWarnings.uncertaintyPage: An uncertainty references a page that is not present in the extracted text.
analysisWarnings.confirmedOutcome: A repair is marked confirmed without a linked confirmed outcome. Its confirmation should be checked against the source.
analysisWarnings.generic: This analysis has a non-blocking quality note that can be checked against the source.
analysisWarnings.evidenceNotice: Supporting passages may be reformulated for clarity; they are not necessarily verbatim quotations. The original PDF and extracted text remain available for comparison.

history.title: Extraction history
history.empty: No extraction attempt has been recorded yet.

attemptErrors.interrupted: The processing worker was interrupted and the source became available for retry.

attemptErrors.incomplete: The provider returned an incomplete response.
attemptErrors.invalidResponse: The provider response could not be read.
attemptErrors.invalidStructure: The extracted result did not match the required structure.
